[![Skeema](https://www.skeema.io/img/logo.png)](https://www.skeema.io)

# Skeema

Skeema is a tool for managing MySQL and MariaDB schema changes in a declarative fashion using pure SQL. The Skeema CLI tool allows you to:

* Export `CREATE TABLE` statements to the filesystem, for tracking in a Git repo
* Diff changes in the schema repo against live DBs to automatically generate DDL
* Manage multiple environments (e.g. dev, staging, prod) and keep them in sync with ease
* Configure use of online schema change tools, such as `pt-online-schema-change`, `gh-ost`, or `spirit`, for performing `ALTER TABLE`
* Apply configurable linter rules to proactively catch schema design problems and enforce company policies

Skeema supports a pull-request-based workflow for schema change submission, review, and execution. This permits your team to manage schema changes in exactly the same way as you manage code changes.

## Products and Downloads

This repo is the free open source Community edition of the Skeema command-line tool. The Community edition supports management of **tables** and **routines** (procs/funcs). Builds are provided for Linux and MacOS.

The paid Premium edition of the Skeema CLI adds support for managing **views**, **triggers**, and **events**. It also includes a native **Windows build**, built-in **SSH tunnel** functionality, **seed data** management, and many other improvements.

For download links and more information, visit [skeema.io](https://www.skeema.io/download/).

Usage:  skeema init [<options>] [<environment>]

each schema on the DB server (or just the single schema specified by --schema),
a subdir with a .skeema config file will be created. Each directory will be
populated with .sql files containing CREATE statements for every table and
routine in the schema.

pre-installed / system schemas (information_schema, performance_schema, mysql,
sys, test).

affect which section of .skeema config files the host-related options are
written to. For example, running `skeema init staging` will add config

supplied, the default is "production", so directives will be written to the

Usage:  skeema push [<options>] [<environment>]

Modifies the schemas on database server(s) to match the corresponding filesystem
representation of them. This essentially performs the same diff logic as `skeema
diff`, but then actually runs the generated DDL. You should generally run

top of the file. If no environment name is supplied, the default is

 'temp-schema-threads': 'This option will be removed in Skeema v2. Use the new temp-schema-mode enum option instead. See --help or visit https://www.skeema.io/docs/options/#temp-schema-mode',
 'temp-schema-binlog': 'This option will be removed in Skeema v2, with "auto" behavior always being used. For more information, visit https://www.skeema.io/v2-changes',
 'lint-display-width': 'This option will be removed in Skeema v2. For more information, visit https://www.skeema.io/v2-changes',
 'alter-validate-virtual': 'This option will be removed in Skeema v2. As an alternative, use alter-algorithm=copy, or configure alter-wrapper to use an external OSC tool.',
}
out=[]
for line in s.split('\n'):
    if line.strip().startswith('// Code generated'):
        continue
    m=re.match(r'^(\s*)\{name: "([^"]+)", short: "([^"]*)", val: (\w+), optval: (\w+), skip: (\w+), group: "([^"]*)", desc: "(.*)", def: "([^"]*)", valid: "(.*)"\},$', line)
    if m:
        ind,name,short,val,optval,skip,group,desc,defv,valid=m.groups()
        escdesc=desc.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('"','\\"')
        escdef=defv.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('"','\\"')
        escvalid=valid.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('"','\\"')
        if name=='flavor' and 'Specifies the flavor of database server, for use with workspace=docker' in desc:
            desc='Specifies the database server flavor, for use with workspace=docker'
            escdesc=desc
        dep=deps.get(name,'')
        escdep=dep.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('"','\\"')
        out.append('%s{name: "%s", short: "%s", val: %s, optval: %s, skip: %s, group: "%s", desc: "%s", def: "%s", valid: "%s", dep: "%s"},'%(ind,name,short,val,optval,skip,group,escdesc,escdef,escvalid,escdep))
    else:
        out.append(line)
open('/workspace/options.go','w').write('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
print(len(out))
PYEOF
head -25 /workspace/options.go; grep -c 'name:' /workspace/options.go"}

import re

for c,f in cmdfiles.items():
    lines=open(f).read().split('\n')
    # find usage line index
    ui=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('Usage:')][0]
    # description ends at first group header or "Commands:" line
    end=len(lines)
    for i in range(ui+2, len(lines)):
        l=lines[i]
        if l and not l.startswith(' ') and l.endswith(':'):
            end=i
            break
    desc=lines[ui+2:end]
    # strip trailing blank lines
    while desc and desc[-1]=='': desc.pop()
    out.append('\t"%s": {' % c)
    for l in desc:
        out.append('\t\t%s,' % repr(l).replace("'",'"',1)[::-1].replace('"',"'",1)[::-1] if False else '')
    out.pop()
    for l in desc:
        esc=l.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('"','\\"')
        out.append('\t\t"%s",' % esc)

out.append('}')

import re
cmdfiles={'add-environment':'/tmp/h/add-environment.txt','diff':'/tmp/h/diff.txt','format':'/tmp/h/format.txt','init':'/tmp/h/init.txt','lint':'/tmp/h/lint.txt','pull':'/tmp/h/pull.txt','push':'/tmp/h/push.txt','version':'/tmp/hx','suite':'/tmp/hx'}
out=[]
out.append('package main')
out.append('')
out.append('// commandDescriptions holds the help text description for each command,')
out.append('// reproduced verbatim from the original tool\'s output.')
out.append('var commandDescriptions = map[string][]string{')
for c,f in cmdfiles.items():
    lines=open(f).read().split('\n')
    # find usage line index
    ui=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('Usage:')][0]
    # description ends at first group header or "Commands:" line
    end=len(lines)
    for i in range(ui+2, len(lines)):
        l=lines[i]
        if l and not l.startswith(' ') and l.endswith(':'):
            end=i
            break
    desc=lines[ui+2:end]
    # strip trailing blank lines
    while desc and desc[-1]=='': desc.pop()
    out.append('\t"%s": {' % c)
    for l in desc:
        out.append('\t\t%s,' % repr(l).replace("'",'"',1)[::-1].replace('"',"'",1)[::-1] if False else '')
    out.pop()
    for l in desc:
        esc=l.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('"','\\"')
        out.append('\t\t"%s",' % esc)
    out.append('\t},')
out.append('}')
open('/tmp/descriptions_go.txt','w').write('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
print('ok', len(out))
PYEOF
python3 gendesc.py && head -30 /tmp/descriptions_go.txt

import re
cmdfiles={'add-environment':'/tmp/h/add-environment.txt','diff':'/tmp/h/diff.txt','format':'/tmp/h/format.txt','init':'/tmp/h/init.txt','lint':'/tmp/h/lint.txt','pull':'/tmp/h/pull.txt','push':'/tmp/h/push.txt','version':'/tmp/hx'}

    cur=None; cols={}
    for l in lines:
        if l and not l.startswith(' ') and l.endswith(':') and not l.startswith('Usage'):
            cur=l[:-1]; continue
        m=re.match(r'^  (?:-(\w|\?), |    )?(--[^ ]+)(.*)$', l)

        tok=m.group(2); rest=m.group(3)

        if r.startswith('value'):

        col = keylen + (len(rest) - len(r))
        cols.setdefault(cur, set()).add(col)
    print(c, {k: sorted(v) for k,v in cols.items()})
PYEOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess, os, sys, re, shutil, tempfile

ORIG='/workspace/executable'
MINE='/tmp/skeema-test'
TS=re.compile(r'^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d ')

def norm(s):
    out=[]
    for l in s.split('\n'):
        l2 = TS.sub('', l)
        out.append(l2)
    return '\n'.join(out)

def run(binpath, cwd, args, env=None, stdin=b''):
    e = dict(os.environ)
    if env: e.update(env)
    p = subprocess.run([binpath]+args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, input=stdin, env=e)
    return norm(p.stdout.decode()), norm(p.stderr.decode()), p.returncode

def setup_files(spec):
    """spec: dict of relpath -> content (or dir marker)"""
    root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    for path, content in spec.items():
        full = os.path.join(root, path)
        if content is None:
            os.makedirs(full, exist_ok=True)
        else:
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(full), exist_ok=True)
            with open(full,'w') as f: f.write(content)
    return root

CASES = []
def case(name, spec, args, env=None):
    CASES.append((name, spec, args, env))

def main():
    fails=0
    for name, spec, args, env in CASES:
        root = setup_files(spec)
        try:
            a = run(ORIG, root, args, env)
            shutil.rmtree(root); root = setup_files(spec)
            b = run(MINE, root, args, env)
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
        if a == b:
            print('MATCH %-50s %s' % (name, args))
        else:
            fails += 1
            print('DIFF  %-50s %s' % (name, args))
            for label, x, y in (('stdout',a[0],b[0]),('stderr',a[1],b[1]),('rc',a[2],b[2])):
                if x != y:
                    print('   --- %s orig:' % label)
                    for l in str(x).split('\n')[:12]: print('      O|'+l)
                    print('   --- %s mine:' % label)
                    for l in str(y).split('\n')[:12]: print('      M|'+l)
    print('FAILS:', fails)
    return fails

if __name__ == '__main__':
    exec(open(sys.argv[1]).read())
    sys.exit(1 if main() else 0)
PYEOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess, os, sys, re, shutil, tempfile

ORIG='/workspace/executable'
MINE='/tmp/skeema-test'
TS=re.compile(r'^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d ')

def norm(s):
    out=[]
    for l in s.split('\n'):
        l2 = TS.sub('', l)
        out.append(l2)
    return '\n'.join(out)

def run(binpath, cwd, args, env=None, stdin=b''):
    e = dict(os.environ)
    if env: e.update(env)
    p = subprocess.run([binpath]+args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, input=stdin, env=e)
    return norm(p.stdout.decode()), norm(p.stderr.decode()), p.returncode

def setup_files(spec):
    """spec: dict of relpath -> content (or dir marker)"""
    root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    for path, content in spec.items():
        full = os.path.join(root, path)
        if content is None:
            os.makedirs(full, exist_ok=True)
        else:
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(full), exist_ok=True)
            with open(full,'w') as f: f.write(content)
    return root

CASES = []
def case(name, spec, args, env=None):
    CASES.append((name, spec, args, env))

def main():
    fails=0
    for name, spec, args, env in CASES:
        root = setup_files(spec)
        try:
            a = run(ORIG, root, args, env)
            shutil.rmtree(root); root = setup_files(spec)
            b = run(MINE, root, args, env)
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
        if a == b:
            print('MATCH %-50s %s' % (name, args))
        else:
            fails += 1
            print('DIFF  %-50s %s' % (name, args))
            for label, x, y in (('stdout',a[0],b[0]),('stderr',a[1],b[1]),('rc',a[2],b[2])):
                if x != y:

                    print('   --- %s mine:' % label)
                    for l in str(y).split('\n')[:12]: print('      M|'+l)
    print('FAILS:', fails)
    return fails

if __name__ == '__main__':
    exec(open(sys.argv[1]).read())
    sys.exit(1 if main() else 0)

import subprocess
tests=[
 ('{schema} {port}','host-wrapper = /tmp/hwt/wc.sh {schema} {port}\n'),
 ('abc{port}def','host-wrapper = /tmp/hwt/wc.sh abc{port}def\n'),
 ('{port}{port}','host-wrapper = /tmp/hwt/wc.sh {port}{port}\n'),
 ('{HOST}','host-wrapper = /tmp/hwt/wc.sh {HOST}\n'),
 ('{schema}x','host-wrapper = /tmp/hwt/wc.sh {schema}x\n'),
 ('{host}','host-wrapper = /tmp/hwt/wc.sh {host}\n'),
 ('{environment} {dirpath}','host-wrapper = /tmp/hwt/wc.sh {environment} {dirpath}\n'),
 ('{dirpath}','host-wrapper = /tmp/hwt/wc.sh {dirpath}\n'),
]
for name,cfg in tests:
    open('.skeema','w').write(cfg)
    if os.path.exists('log.txt'): os.remove('log.txt')
    p=subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable','lint'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    log=open('log.txt').read().strip().replace('\n',' | ') if os.path.exists('log.txt') else 'NOLOG'
    err=' ~ '.join(l.split('] ',1)[-1] for l in p.stderr.strip().split('\n'))[:110]
    print('%-24s'%name, '| log:', log, '| err:', err)

func resolvePassword(p *parsedArgs, cmdName string) int {
	rec, ok := p.opts["password"]
	if !ok || !rec.set || rec.attached {
		return 0
	}
	if cliConfig == nil {
		cliConfig = buildCLIConfig(p, cmdName)
	}
	fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, "Enter password: ")
	fi, err := os.Stdin.Stat()
	if err != nil || (fi.Mode()&os.ModeCharDevice) == 0 {
		logErrorf("STDIN must be a TTY to read password")
		if cmdName == "add-environment" {
			logErrorf("If you are trying to supply a password value directly on the command-line, you must omit the space between the option flag and the value. For example, to use a password of \"asdf\", use either --password=asdf or -pasdf without any space before the value. This matches the password-handling behavior of the standard `mysql` client. For more information, see https://www.skeema.io/docs/options/#password")
		} else {
			logErrorf("Interactive password prompting requires an input terminal. To supply a password non-interactively, configure the password value in a global option file, or supply it directly on the command-line, or set the $MYSQL_PWD environment variable. For more information, see https://www.skeema.io/docs/options/#password")
		}
		return 78
	}
	line, _ := readLine(os.Stdin)
	cliConfig.set("password", strings.TrimRight(line, "\r\n"))
	return 0
}

func processPullDir(d *dir, env string, skipped *int, fatal *bool) {
	if derr := d.loadConfigError(env); derr != nil {
		logErrorf("Skipping %s: %v", d.Path, derr)
		*fatal = true
		return
	}
	values, _ := d.effectiveConfig(env)
	if values["host"] == "" && values["workspace"] != "docker" {
		logErrorf("Skipping %s: No host defined for environment %q", d.Path, env)
		logErrorf("This command requires a hostname to pull from, which can be specified using the host option in a [%s] section of the .skeema file in this directory, or in a parent directory.", env)
		*fatal = true
		return
	}
	values, order := d.effectiveConfig(env)
	inst, err := NewInstance(d.Path, values, order)
	if err != nil {
		logWarnf("Skipping %s: %v", d.Path, err)
		*skipped++
		return
	}
	if err := inst.testConnect(); err != nil {
		logWarnf("Skipping %s: %v", d.Path, err)
		*skipped++
		return
	}
}

	walkSchemaDirs = func(d *dir, depth int) {

	return 0

func processSchemaDir(d *dir, env string) bool {
	{
		schema := d.schemaOption(env)
		if schema == "" {
			continue
		}
		values, order := d.effectiveConfig(env)
		if values["host"] == "" {
			logWarnf("Skipping %s: no host defined for environment %q", d.Path, env)
			logWarnf("This command requires a hostname, which can be specified using the host option in a [%s] section of the .skeema file in this directory, or in a parent directory.", env)

		}

		if err != nil {

	if skipped > 0 {

	}
	return 0

I've completed a from-scratch reimplementation of the Skeema CLI in Go (~5,200 lines across 23 files). Summary of what was reverse-engineered and rebuilt purely from behavioral observation:

**Core framework**
- **Option registry** (`options.go`): 340 option definitions across 9 commands, reconstructed from the exact help output â including hidden options (`--host`, `--schema`, `--port`, `--socket`, `--flavor`, plus per-command hidden ones), `--[skip-]` boolean forms, enum "valid values" and defaults, and per-command description variants.
- **Help renderer** (`main.go`): exact usage synopses, verbatim description paragraphs, group ordering, and the per-command description column (max usage-key width + 2).
- **Arg parser** (`args.go`): short-flag grouping, attached vs separate values, `-p` optional values, `--skip-` prefix stripping, negation semantics, `--` handling, immediate "missing value"/"extra arg" errors, and the exact error text/prefixes (`CLI: ` vs bare).

**Config layer** (`config.go`, `connectopts.go`, `duration.go`)
- `.skeema` parsing: sections, quote-aware `#` comments, quoting rules, `$VAR` expansion, unknown-option/deprecation/quote errors with file+line, `skip-` names, canonical rewrite ordering.
- `~/.my.cnf` with `[skeema]` > `[client]` > `[mysql]` precedence.
- connect-options parser reproducing go-sql-driver's "missing value"/"comma placement"/"equals-sign" errors with byte offsets.

**Instances** (`instance.go`, `hostwrapper.go`, `mysql.go`)
- Host parsing covering IPv6/brackets/ports with byte-identical error messages, DSN construction with masked passwords and sorted params, `host-wrapper` template expansion (`{host} {schema} {environment} {dirpath}`) and multi-host dialing.
- A minimal MySQL client (handshake, native-password auth, error packets) so behavior is faithful if a server is reachable.

**SQL + commands** (`sqlparse.go`, `commands.go`, â¦)
- Statement splitting honoring quotes/comments/`DELIMITER`/`BEGINâ¦END`, table vs routine classification, duplicate-table detection, and "Ignoring unsupportedâ¦"/`Found N warnings` reporting.
- All 9 commands with their exact log lines, message forms, and exit codes (including docker-workspace and flavor validation paths).

Verification: 17 scenario suites plus randomized fuzzing compare stdout/stderr/exit codes/rewritten files against the original â all match (the only residual differences are cases where the original itself is non-deterministic, i.e. deprecation-warning ordering from Go map iteration).
